name: scalpel
summary: A frugal, high performance file carver.
highlights: -b — Carve files even if defined footers aren't discovered within maximum carve size for file t
-d — Generate header/footer database; will bypass certain optimizations and discover all footer
-i — Read names of disk images from specified file.
-m — Generate/update carve coverage blockmap file. The first 32bit unsigned int in the file ide
-n — Don't add extensions to extracted files.
-o — Set output directory for carved files.
-O — Don't organize carved files by type. Default is to organize carved files into subdirectori

flags.name: -b
flags.description: Carve files even if defined footers aren't discovered within maximum carve size for file type [foremost 0.69 compat mode].

flags.name: -d
flags.description: Generate header/footer database; will bypass certain optimizations and discover all footers, so performance suffers. Doesn't affect the set of files carved. **EXPERIMENTAL**

flags.name: -h
flags.description: Print this help message and exit.

flags.name: -i
flags.description: Read names of disk images from specified file.

flags.name: -m
flags.description: Generate/update carve coverage blockmap file. The first 32bit unsigned int in the file identifies the block size. Thereafter each 32bit unsigned int entry in the blockmap file corresponds to one block in the image file. Each entry counts how many carved files contain this block. Requires more memory and disk. **EXPERIMENTAL**

flags.name: -n
flags.description: Don't add extensions to extracted files.

flags.name: -o
flags.description: Set output directory for carved files.

flags.name: -O
flags.description: Don't organize carved files by type. Default is to organize carved files into subdirectories.

flags.name: -p
flags.description: Perform image file preview; audit log indicates which files would have been carved, but no files are actually carved.

flags.name: -q
flags.description: Carve only when header is cluster-aligned.

flags.name: -r
flags.description: Find only first of overlapping headers/footers [foremost 0.69 compat mode].

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Skip n bytes in each disk image before carving.

flags.name: -u
flags.description: Use carve coverage blockmap when carving. Carve only sections of the image whose entries in the blockmap are 0. These areas are treated as contiguous regions. **EXPERIMENTAL**

examples.explanation: Carve files from a disk image using a specific configuration file
Preview which files would be carved, without actually carving them
Skip the first N bytes of the disk image before carving
Carve files without organizing them into subdirectories by type
